stories.title: Brasil enfrenta a Índia perto de país onde Pelé virou 'deus do futebol'; entenda

en.title: Brazil faces India near country where Pelé became 'god of football'; understand
en.summary: The Brazilian national team plays its first-ever match against India in a friendly in Calcutta, located near Bangladesh, a region with significant Brazilian supporters influenced by Pelé's legacy.

stories.title: Sábado terá chuva forte no Sudeste e temporais no Sul; veja previsão neste fim de semana de eleições

en.title: Saturday will have heavy rain in Southeast and storms in South; see forecast for this election weekend
en.summary: Heavy rainfall is expected in parts of Southeast Brazil and severe storms in the South on the eve of the first round of 2026 elections, caused by low pressure systems affecting the region.

stories.title: O que se sabe sobre brasileira suspeita de matar filha de 4 anos nos EUA após perder a guarda

en.title: What is known about Brazilian suspected of killing 4-year-old daughter in USA after losing custody
en.summary: A 35-year-old Brazilian woman is suspected of shooting her four-year-old daughter and herself hours after a court in Texas awarded custody to the child's father.

stories.title: Esposa de estudante de medicina morto após ser baleado em briga de trânsito em Taubaté fala sobre perda: ‘Foi covardia’

en.title: Wife of medical student killed after being shot in traffic fight in Taubaté speaks about loss: 'It was cowardice'
en.summary: The widow of a 23-year-old medical student discusses her husband's death during a traffic dispute in São Paulo, describing the tragedy and difficulty of explaining his absence to their son.

stories.title: AGU pede ao STF que declare inconstitucionais leis que legalizaram e regulamentaram bets

en.title: AGU asks STF to declare laws that legalized and regulated bets unconstitutional
en.summary: Brazil's Attorney General's Office has requested that the Supreme Federal Court rule unconstitutional the legislation that legalized and established regulatory frameworks for betting operations.

stories.title: Após dificuldades contra a Austrália, Brasil enfrenta a frágil Índia

en.title: After difficulties against Australia, Brazil faces fragile India
en.summary: The Brazilian national team faces India, ranked 138th in FIFA standings and a first-time opponent, on Saturday following challenging matches against Australia.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: veja como foi o 48º dia de campanha dos candidatos ao governo do Amapá

en.title: 2026 Elections: see how the 48th day of campaign for candidates for governor of Amapá went
en.summary: Candidates for Amapá governor completed their 48th official campaign day on Friday, with activities including walks, leafleting, and internal coordination meetings. The first election round is scheduled for October 4.

stories.title: Justiça determina prisão de bombeiro que matou estudante de medicina em Taubaté (SP)

en.title: Court orders arrest of firefighter who killed medical student in Taubaté (SP)
en.summary: A military firefighter has been ordered held in preventive custody for fatally shooting a 23-year-old medical student following a traffic dispute in São Paulo state.

stories.title: Renan Santos, candidato à Presidência pelo Missão, tem agenda em São Paulo

en.title: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for Missão, has agenda in São Paulo
en.summary: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, campaigned in São Paulo on Friday, arriving in the evening for a podcast interview in the city's South Zone. He discussed government proposals including a managerial accountability law for mayors.

stories.title: Santos vira sobre o São Paulo com participação de Coutinho e gols de Gabigol

en.title: Santos defeats São Paulo with Coutinho's participation and Gabigol's goals
en.summary: Santos beat São Paulo 2-1 in a Brazilian Championship match on Friday at Morumbi stadium, resuming play after a two-week pause. The match was scheduled during the international FIFA window as a makeup game.

stories.title: Gabigol vira para o Santos, com estreia de Coutinho e roteiro repetido do São Paulo no Brasileirão

en.title: Gabigol scores for Santos, with Coutinho's debut and repeated script for São Paulo in the Championship
en.summary: Gabigol scored as Santos defeated São Paulo, with Coutinho making his debut for the team in a Brazilian Championship match.

stories.title: Veja como foi a sexta-feira (2) dos candidatos a presidente

en.title: See how Friday (2) was for presidential candidates
en.summary: Presidential candidates held campaign activities on Friday, including rallies and campaign events across different cities in the final days before the first round of the 2026 elections.

stories.title: Gilmar Mendes anula afastamento e restabelece desembargador do TJAL

en.title: Gilmar Mendes annuls removal and reinstates TJAL judge
en.summary: Supreme Federal Court minister Gilmar Mendes overturned a decision by the national justice ombudsman and ordered the immediate reinstatement of judge Tutmés Airan de Albuquerque Melo to the Alagoas Court of Justice.

stories.title: Lula agradece Alcolumbre por pautar PEC sobre fim da escala 6x1

en.title: Lula thanks Alcolumbre for scheduling PEC on ending 6x1 work shift
en.summary: President Lula thanked Senate president Davi Alcolumbre for including a constitutional amendment to end the 6x1 work schedule on the legislative agenda for the following week.

stories.title: Controladora propõe OPA para fechamento de capital da Unifique

en.title: Controlling shareholder proposes takeover bid for Unifique capital closure
en.summary: Unifique's controlling shareholder announced a public takeover offer to acquire remaining shares at 6.00 reais per share and delist the telecommunications company from the stock exchange.

stories.title: Poste Italiane eleva participação na Telecom Italia para quase 87%

en.title: Poste Italiane raises stake in Telecom Italia to nearly 87%
en.summary: Italian state-owned Poste Italiane completed a voluntary public offer for Telecom Italia shares, increasing its ownership to approximately 86.95% of the telecommunications company.

stories.title: Campanha de Lula lança minidocumentário com 'currículo' de Flávio

en.title: Lula's campaign launches mini-documentary with Flávio's 'résumé'
en.summary: President Lula's reelection campaign released a mini-documentary on Friday highlighting senator Flávio Bolsonaro's political history, corruption scandals, and alleged connections to various controversies, warning against his potential election.
